title: Bijli ka taapmaan suraj ki surface se 5 guna zyada!
source: NOAA National Weather Service · UCAR · NASA

captions.instagram:
The lightning you see is five times hotter than the surface of the Sun!

Jo bijli tum dekhte ho, woh Suraj ki surface se 5 guna garam hai ⚡

⚡☀️ Bijli apne aaspaas ki hawa ko ~28,000°C tak garam kar deti hai, Suraj ki surface (~5,500°C) se 5 guna zyada! Lekin Suraj ka core? 1.5 crore °C 😎

Sources: NOAA National Weather Service, NASA, UCAR.
Photos: James Niland / Flickr (CC BY 2.0); NASA, from the ISS (Public domain).
